changeStatus: UNCHANGED in window (interaction-coupled orchestrator; the depositFor round-trip on a SINGLE staker is exactly the path the audit-21 M-03/V2 fix targets).
role: Single-staker in-place rewire orchestrator: migrateOut parks ERC1155 in own custody (cross-TRANSACTION custody, unlike NFTStakerMigrator), owner rewires the empty staker (finalizeAndReset + setters), migrateIn re-injects parked stake via depositFor. Timeout hatch returns stake to users if the operator stalls.

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: migrateIn slices [start,end) with end clamped; parked set paged via parkedUsersRange; owner-driven
verifiedProperties.custodyExits: parked stake has exactly TWO exits: migrateIn -> staker.depositFor(user, amount) (immutable staker, original user) and claimTimedOut -> user themselves. No owner redirect path. staker/timeout immutable by design.
verifiedProperties.timeoutBounds: 1 day <= migrationTimeout <= 30 days (immutable; rejects instant-hatch and infinite-hatch)
verifiedProperties.floors: rescueERC1155(stakedId) floored by totalParked; rescueERC20(rewardToken) floored by totalUnforwarded -- owner cannot reach parked principal or escrowed reward
verifiedProperties.cei: migrateIn zeroes parked/migrationBegin/totalParked BEFORE depositFor; claimTimedOut and claimForwarded strict CEI
verifiedProperties.setSemantics: manual swap-remove parked set (1-based index map), idempotent add/remove; migrateIn snapshots slice to memory before mutating (index-shift safe)
verifiedProperties.captureAndForward: same verified mechanism as NFTStakerMigrator; owed read on `staker` (source == target)

localFindings.description: Migration-cluster triage (2026-07-23 memory): M-03/M-04/M-08 slice-ordering findings -> conditional wont-fix (dust for minutes-long migration); M-05 stake()-wedge -> fix-pending as load-bearing backstop -- story-027's stake() Active gate on V2/MigrateReady is the candidate fix for that backstop; downstream agents should evaluate whether bdf84579/M-05 reopen-triggers are now satisfied for NEW deployments (V1 mainnet instances remain ungated).

claimTimedOut vs migrateIn race is bounded: both zero parked[user] first under nonReentrant+CEI, so double-pay is impossible; whichever lands first wins, the other no-ops/skips. Timeout hatch returns STAKE ONLY (pending was settled at migrateOut) -- correct, no reward stranding.

externalCalls: per user: staker.pendingReward, rewardToken.balanceOf, staker.depositFor, rewardToken.transfer(user) try/catch
externalEntryPoints.notes: requires staker back in Active (finalizeAndReset + rewire done) or depositFor reverts

externalEntryPoints.access: public self-only, nonReentrant, requires timeout elapsed

staker's stakedToken/stakedId match constructor args (wiring assumption; rewardToken IS cross-checked)
